he.text: יְיָ בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ בֹּקֶר נַעֲרָךְ־לְךָ וּנְצַפֶּה׃ אַל־תִּנְאַץ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ אַל־תְּנַבֵּל כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ זְכֹר אַל־תָּפֵר בְּרִיתְךָ אִתָּנוּ׃ וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי לְךָ יְיָ עֵת־רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃

en.text: O Lord, in the morning thou hearest our voice; in the morning we will direct our prayers unto thee, and will look up. Do not abhor us for thy name’s sake; do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us. But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy, hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
